name: Metzler
aliases: B. Metzler seel. Sohn & Co. AG
desc: Family-owned Frankfurt private bank founded in 1674, active in asset management, capital markets, corporate finance and private banking.
products: Asset management, capital markets, corporate finance, private banking
customers: Institutional investors, corporates and wealthy private clients
marketing_autonomy_basis: independent family-owned bank with no parent group
stores_or_sites: Frankfurt plus Düsseldorf, Hamburg, Munich, Stuttgart, Atlanta, Los Angeles, Seattle, Beijing and Tokyo
markets: Germany mainly, with offices in the United States, China and Japan serving institutional and private clients
profitability_basis: Wikipedia gives only a distributable profit (Bilanzgewinn) of EUR 2.31m for 2022, not net income; core capital ratio above 20%
fit_rationale: Discreet 350-year-old family bank whose institutional and private-client business runs on relationships; race hospitality could serve clients, but its low-profile brand culture makes a visible F1 deal less natural.
category_conflict: potential: banking and wealth management partners exist across teams (e.g. UBS as F1 global partner); verify against current roster
f1_markets: Germany (no race), United States, China, Japan

access.roles: Management board (Vorstand), Head of Marketing and Communications

outstanding: Current AUM and earnings (2024/25 annual report); whether the bank sponsors any sport or culture today
discovery_source: analyst seed list (subsector brainstorm; not from a page)

name: Dornbracht
aliases: Aloys F. Dornbracht GmbH & Co. KG

products: Washbasin, bath, shower and WC fittings, spa showers, kitchen faucets and sinks, accessories

marketing_autonomy_basis: stand-alone brand company; long record of its own art and culture programmes
stores_or_sites: one production site (Iserlohn); 19 sales subsidiaries worldwide
markets: Global premium sanitary market through 19 sales subsidiaries; Germany-based production

alt_indicators.evidence: about 800 employees (2022)
19 sales subsidiaries worldwide

distress: Former subsidiary Alape filed for insolvency in July 2023 (taken over by Roca in October 2023); legal form changed from AG & Co. KG to GmbH & Co. KG at end of 2024

sponsorships.rights_holder: Guggenheim New York; Neue Nationalgalerie Berlin

f1_markets: Global premium design markets incl. UAE, US, UK, Italy, China (subsidiary countries not listed on page)

access.roles: Managing Director, Head of Brand and Marketing

outstanding: Revenue after 2019; current owner structure after Knauf majority; list of subsidiary countries

name: SCT Logistics
desc: Family-owned Australian interstate rail and road freight operator running its own locomotives and terminals in six state capitals and Parkes.
products: Interstate intermodal rail freight, road freight, terminals and warehousing, bulk steel trains, locomotive hire
customers: Shippers and industrial customers, including BlueScope bulk steel trains
stores_or_sites: terminals in Brisbane, Sydney, Parkes, Melbourne, Adelaide, Perth; Bromelton Intermodal Estate (QLD)
markets: Australia: east-west and north-south interstate freight corridors between Brisbane, Sydney, Melbourne, Adelaide and Perth

fin.value_orig: AUD 458.0m revenue (balance date 6/22; IBISWorld Top 500 Private 2022 rank 147; older than 3 years)

qualifying_metric: revenue (FY2022, older than three years; flag)

alt_indicators.evidence: about 2,000 employees (2020)
naming-rights sponsor of Brad Jones Racing Supercars entry since 2020; supported Tommy Smith in 2023 FIA Formula 3

sponsorships.designation: naming-rights sponsor of No. 4 Holden Commodore ZB

outstanding: Revenue after FY2022; current sponsorship portfolio; whether driver links continue in 2026

name: Techwool Trading
desc: Australian family-owned supplier of greasy wool, buying from farms and at auction for export to textile-producing countries.
customers: Wool textile processors in China, India, Japan, Egypt and Europe
markets: Buys in Australia; exports to China, India, Japan, Egypt and Europe

qualifying_metric: revenue (FY2022, older than three years; flag)

name: CPP Investments
desc: Canadian Crown corporation that invests the Canada Pension Plan's assets worldwide across equities, credit, real estate, infrastructure and private markets.
products: Global investment management for the Canada Pension Plan
customers: Canada Pension Plan contributors and beneficiaries (single mandate); co-investment partners and fund managers
parent_ultimate: Government of Canada (Crown corporation, arm's length; accountable to Parliament)
marketing_autonomy_basis: arm's-length Crown corporation; no consumer marketing function evident
markets: Invests globally: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific and Latin America (e.g. Korea, Brazil, China, UK deals on page)

alt_indicators.evidence: 2,418 employees (Clay / LinkedIn count)

profitability_basis: CAD 56.9bn net income in fiscal 2026 (investment income)
distress: Missed benchmark targets in fiscal 2025 and 2026; governance criticism over compensation plan

signals.what: Agreed to invest up to USD 1.05bn for an indirect stake in Castrol, in a Stonepeak-led deal

fit_rationale: Huge global investor, but a single-mandate public pension manager has little reason to buy brand exposure and faces public scrutiny on spending; realistic only as hospitality around deal partners.
customer_overlap: Taking an indirect stake in Castrol (lubricants brand with motorsport history); no current F1 link stated on page
f1_markets: Canada, United States, United Kingdom, Brazil, China, plus global portfolio

access.roles: President and CEO, Chief Communications / Public Affairs officer

compliance: public-sector governance constraints on discretionary spend likely; verify
outstanding: Whether any sponsorship policy exists; office count; employees from annual report

name: Tripledot Studios
desc: London mobile games publisher behind Woodoku and Solitaire.com that bought AppLovin's games business, running 12 studios in 23 cities.
products: Casual mobile games: Woodoku, Solitaire.com, Wordscapes, Project Makeover, Clockmaker, Cash Tornado Slots; studios Lion Studios, Belka Games, Magic Tavern, PeopleFun
customers: Mobile gamers (25m+ daily active users) and advertisers
minority_investors: AppLovin (20% equity stake from the games-business sale)
marketing_autonomy_basis: independent publisher (described as one of the largest independent mobile publishers)
markets: Global mobile app stores; studios across 23 cities

USD 800m acquisition of AppLovin's games business (plus 20% equity to AppLovin)

over 2,500 staff across 12 studios in 23 cities
rank 20 in PocketGamer.biz Top 50 Mobile Game Makers of 2025

access.roles: CEO / co-founders, CMO, Head of User Acquisition

name: Mukwano Group

operations in Uganda plus Kenya (Mombasa oil terminal) and Tanzania (Dar es Salaam)

name: Jula
subsector: DIY, tools and home improvement retail
desc: Swedish family-owned retail chain selling tools, DIY, garden and leisure products through 160+ stores in four countries and online.
products: Tools, DIY, garden, home, leisure and motoring products; mail order and e-commerce
customers: Consumers and tradespeople in the Nordics and Poland

marketing_autonomy_basis: owner-controlled group; runs its own national TV advertising (2018-2021 campaign)
markets: Sweden, Norway, Poland and Finland, plus online

national TV advertising series 2018-2021

name: East Penn

products: Deka motive power, transportation, reserve power batteries; wire and cable; lithium (Navitas Systems); MK Battery
customers: Vehicle makers and equipment OEMs (supplier awards from Honda and John Deere), distributors

markets: North America chiefly, with worldwide customers via East Penn Canada and East Penn International in Asia-Pacific

supplier sustainability awards from Honda and John Deere
